Maize Weather Data

Source: R/data_maizeWTH.R
maizeWTH.Rd

Weather data collected from NASA POWER for each one of the five environments in HELIX dataset.

Usage

data(maizeWTH)

Format

A data.frame containing weather variables for each environment in HEL dataset

Examples

# \donttest{
data(maizeWTH); head(maizeWTH)
#>   env       LON       LAT YEAR MM DD DOY   YYYYMMDD   T2M T2M_MAX T2M_MIN
